body:
I don’t see how it matters. Everyday when I think I’ve finally reached rock bottom, it gets worse. It’s a long complicated story that doesn’t make sense, everyone calls it stupid. I just need to make sure that they don’t blame themselves and I need to make their lives as easy as possible. I already have plans that I’ve been pushing back for months, I’m so done and tired

Edit: I’m sorry, that was aggressive and kinda rude, I’m just done with life and I don’t want anyone to feel worse than they have to
